luna_art_direction.art_direction_ar: بطاقة عنوان ختامية انتقالية: الأرض تظلم، والعنوان العربي يفتح الطريق إلى ماء أسود. الأولوية للدقة الطباعية والوقار.

cinematic_blueprint.action: Begin with a darkening abstract earth horizon and a thin first-light line. Reveal the exact Arabic title "آدم: التكريم والاختبار" with clear hierarchy. A narrow light line then travels from the title toward a black water surface, ending in a quiet gold reflection.
cinematic_blueprint.atmosphere: Night-blue, elemental, contemplative title transition with restrained archival gravity.
cinematic_blueprint.camera: No lens or camera simulation. Use orthographic local compositing with authored 2.5D layer movement only; the horizon, title, light line, and water are independent layers with a minimal controlled depth shift.
cinematic_blueprint.color_palette: Night blue, deep charcoal, thin antique gold, warm parchment typography, and black reflective water.
cinematic_blueprint.composition: Balanced asymmetry: title occupies the primary safe-area focus, horizon sits low, and the light line provides a single directional path toward the water; maintain generous negative space and exact text legibility.
cinematic_blueprint.continuity: SEQ-02 visual identity; no character location; key direction implied from frame right; right-to-left sequence logic, WET_EARTH_OCHRE_COOL_SHADOW palette, material language, scale, and silhouette remain consistent.
cinematic_blueprint.environment: Abstract horizon and black water graphic layers, not a literal location or cosmological depiction.
cinematic_blueprint.lens: Not applicable to local graphics; orthographic typography and compositing only.
cinematic_blueprint.lighting: A thin first-light accent from frame right, soft antique-gold title edge, and restrained reflection on black water; no visible sun or supernatural source.
cinematic_blueprint.materials: Matte night-blue atmosphere, subtle parchment paper grain in typography, and black water with a controlled low-amplitude reflection.
cinematic_blueprint.safety: Title graphics and abstract natural materials only; no sacred figure, face, body, creature, deity, angel, prophet, Iblis, or literal unseen representation.
cinematic_blueprint.subject: The exact Arabic title "آدم: التكريم والاختبار" and its connecting light line.
cinematic_blueprint.temporal_motion: Fifteen-second graphic sequence: horizon darkens, title resolves cleanly, light line travels toward black water, then reflection settles for a brief readable finish; no morphing glyphs, jitter, illegibility, decorative zoom, random particles, or filler hold.
